description: Search public LEGO listings by name or set number, with optional category, theme, condition and USD price filters. Returns paginated items with title, set number, condition, price, availability and product URL.

category.description: Shop section: all, new (sealed), used (Verified Complete) or coming-soon (not yet purchasable).

condition.description: Filter by condition: new (sealed) or used.

max.description: Maximum price in USD, inclusive; must be at least min.

q.description: Free-text search across set name and set number, e.g. "Millennium Falcon" or "75192". Empty returns all listings.

sort.description: Sort order: newest listed, release year ascending/descending, price ascending/descending, or piece count.

theme.description: Exact LEGO theme name to filter by, e.g. "Star Wars" or "Icons".

name: search_sets
title: Search Sets
